Consent:
Welcome!     



We are researchers interested in how the general public thinks about techniques to modify the functionalities of microorganisms. In the first part of this survey, we will introduce the concept of microbial factories, after which we will ask you different questions to gain insights into how you feel about their use. After that, we will present different applications of microbial factories and ask different questions to get insights into your needs, concerns, and beliefs about these specific applications. Your input will help us align our work as researchers developing microbial factories with practical needs and societal impact.



Your responses will be kept entirely confidential. We will not ask for your name or any other identifying information at any point in the survey. At the end of the survey, we will ask you for information regarding your age, gender, and the place where you currently reside. You can answer the question about gender with 'prefer not to say' if you would rather not disclose this information.

This study was approved by the University of Antwerp Ethics Committee for the Social Sciences and Humanities on 1/10/2024 (file number: SHW_2024_149).



The study should take you around 10 minutes to complete. Your participation in this research is voluntary. You have to be 18 years or older to participate. If you would like to contact the principal investigator in the study to discuss this research, please e-mail Kristien Hens (kristien.hens@uantwerpen.be).
